title: Squid Stir Fry with Slovakian Flair
description: A Chinese-inspired dish with a twist of Slovakia, featuring squid and a hint of saltiness.

ingredients.name: squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: slovakian
ingredients.notes: such as paprika or caraway seeds

ingredients.name: gratin
ingredients.notes: such as soy sauce or rice vinegar

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the squid and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until opaque and slightly charred.
Remove the squid from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the xanthous, salty, and Slovakian ingredients.
Add the gratin and stir to combine.
Return the squid to the wok and toss to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the squid is well coated.
Serve immediately and garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
